situation: Two old friends who have always disagreed about politics, texting while the news is on.
topic: Immigration: it has turned into a shouting match by text, with swearing and personal insults about each other's intelligence and character, each saying the other is a disgrace.

text: Sorry about last night. Calling you thick was out of order. You're not thick
Ta. I called you a disgrace so we're even 🙄
Was a rough one on the ward, didn't sleep after. Sorry for the disgrace bit too
Fair. Can we do the dinner before one of us brings up the boats again
Dev's 50th. 12th or 19th?
12th. 19th I'm on earlies that week
Menu, I say Italian, he went on about curry last time. Ask him? Or not, it's a surprise lol
Surprise so we decide. Curry then. Ladypool Rd place?
Ladypool. Need 8ish?
Ring them Sat 12, 8pm. 8 if Kev comes
Dunno if Kev's coming, he's been weird since the wedding
News is on. Don't
Wasn't going to they're on about the Bill again, I'm muting it
Done. Who books, you or me
You. You've got the nicer phone manner
Ok. Booking tomorrow morning. Kev's a yes if you ask him, I'm not asking him
Asking him. Night
Up. Off on the bus, pharmacy opens at 9
Kev hasn't answered me. Sent it at 10
Left it. He'll come round
Pharmacy's mental today. Man wanted his codeine with no prescription 🙄
Told him to try the GP like everyone else
Just got in. Thirteen hours
One of the older lads on bay 3 went downhill. We were on him till gone 9
Christ. You ok?
Yeah. Just wired. Going to eat something and sit in silence
Ok
Kev says yes. Says he's "not sure about the curry"
Course he is
Ladypool, Sat 12th, 8pm. Booking tomorrow
Ta. Are you ringing me after or just doing it
Ringing you at 9 with the answer
Rang Ladypool. Sat 12th, 8pm, table for 8 is fine
They want a £10pp deposit by Thurs or they let it go. I'll do the card, you pay me back after
Only just woke up. Ta. I'll Monday
Asked Kev. He's a yes. Says he won't eat curry but he'll come for the company
Course he will
Who's doing the cake or is that out of the question
Out of the question. My sister's got a mate does them but she charges like a solicitor
Can ask her though
Dad's fence came down in the wind. The whole side panel. He's blaming the council
He's fine. Moaning at me about it on the phone
Oh no. Tell him the council don't care lol
Off to Tesco. Need milk and something I can eat standing up
Cake: ask the sister's mate, we'll split it
Sorted. Sister's mate says £60 for a 50th, serves 12, I've said yes
Don't argue
Wasn't going to
Sat on the sofa with a cup of tea and nothing on
Had the news on for 5 mins and turned it off. Can't
Don't blame you. Nothing good on it since about 2019
Going to bed early, up at 8 for the pharmacy rota
Night x
